name: Triple systems on 12 points without three disjoint triples
description: construct() -> list of distinct triples [a, b, c] of distinct points in 0..11 containing no three pairwise disjoint triples. Maximize the number of triples; the proven optimum is 100. For n = 12 and s = 2 the maximum is max{56, 100} = 100, attained by all triples meeting two fixed points.

sources.locator: Peter Frankl, On the maximum number of edges in a hypergraph with given matching number (2017). Crossref record and abstract inspected: the maximum number of edges of a 3-uniform hypergraph on n vertices with matching number s is max{C(3s+2,3), C(n,3)-C(n-s,3)} for n >= 3s+2. For n = 12 and s = 2 the maximum is max{56, 100} = 100, attained by all triples meeting two fixed points.
